findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조소의 용수 시험 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 로트 또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing)·재작업(reworking)을 적절히 승인·평가·문서화하지 않았다. 재작업된 로트가 계속(ongoing) 안정성시험 프로그램(경시적 의약품 검체 시험)에 포함되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch. The reworked lot was not included in the ongoing stability program (the testing of drug samples over time).

findings.text_ko: 완제품의 로트 또는 배치가 기준규격에 적합하지 않았음에도 추가 제조 또는 판매에 사용될 수 있는 상태로 두었다.
findings.text_orig: Lots or batches of finished product did not comply with the specifications and were made available for further fabrication or sale.

findings.text_ko: 미생물 및 환경 상태에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및 보관 조건을 입증하는 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 장비가 다른 의약품이나 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 구매 배지의 보관·운송·기록·시험에 관해 마련된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The procedures in place were inadequate for the storage, transportation, records, and/or testing of purchased media.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·유효성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및 유효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다. 제품 및 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자(fabricator), 시험자, 포장자, 표시자(labeller), 유통자, 수입자, 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만사항 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자격을 갖춘 작업자에 의한 원료의 확인 및 칭량·불출이 미흡했다. 측정기기의 정확성 및 정밀성을 정기적으로 점검하지 않았다. 제품 및 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The verification and dispensing of raw materials by qualified staff was inadequate. Measuring devices were not regularly checked for accuracy and precision. The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 수령·조제·취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 기준규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 증거가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조에 사용되는 모든 원료에 대해 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 승인한 기준규격이 구비되어 있지 않았다. 의약품 제조업자의 원료 기준규격이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications approved by the quality control department were not available for all raw materials used to produce drugs. The drug fabricator's specifications for raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 원료 각 로트의 검체에 대해 기준규격 전항목 시험을 실시하지 않았다. 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대해 특이적이고 식별력 있는 시험으로 내용물을 확인하는 시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: A sample from each lot of raw materials was not fully tested against the specifications. Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·요구되는 시험·보관 및/또는 유통(각각의 조건 포함)에 관한 증거의 관리가 미흡했다. 직원 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions. The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체(retention sample)에 관한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·유효성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 보관·운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차 또는 지시에 따른 원료·제품·포장재의 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 장비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조자 간 문서화된 계약의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만사항 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험기관·포장업자·표시업자·유통업자·수입업자·도매업자 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력·관리감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 규격(specification)이 문서화되지 않았거나 품질관리부서 책임자 또는 지정된 대리자의 승인을 받지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications were not in writing and/or approved by the person in charge of the quality control department or the designated alternative.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및 지원설비의 적격성평가(qualification)·검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 확인된 부적합에 대한 재시험 및 원료 공급업체 재평가(re-qualification) 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The method for re-testing identified failures and/or re-qualifying raw material vendors was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·실효성·밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 계속(ongoing) 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주기적 확인시험을 실시하지 않았다. 포장 후 및 수입자 사업장 입고 후 각 의약품 배치에 대한 확인(positive identification)이 미흡했다. 정본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Periodic confirmatory testing was not conducted. The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate. The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.

findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 계속(ongoing) 안정성 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 밸리데이션(validation) 시험을 사전에 정한 프로토콜에 따라 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Validation studies were not conducted in keeping with the predefined protocols.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법을 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았거나 시험방법 이관(method transfer) 시험을 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Test methods were not validated or the method transfer studies were not conducted.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비·실행·품질이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department) 책임자가 실행 전에 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관 및 운송 방법과 절차를 검토·승인하는 것이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업체 간 서면 계약의 구비·내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입업체가 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 규정된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 기준에서 벗어난 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계값에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS)·경계값 또는 경향이탈(OOT)에 해당하는 안정성 시험결과에 대해 회사가 결과를 평가하지 않았거나 시정조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend .

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조에 사용된 원료를 기준서에 따라 시험하지 않았거나, 기준에 적합하지 않았거나, 사용기한이 경과했다. 제조업체의 원료 기준서(specifications)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The raw materials used to fabricate a drug were not tested against the specifications, did not comply with the specifications, and/or were expired. The drug fabricator's specifications for raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다. 공급업체·제조업체·시험기관·포장업체·표시업체·유통업체·수입업체·도매업체 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 오염을 방지하기 위한 설비의 설계·구조·운전·배치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 정제수 시스템이 미흡하여 용수가 화학적·미생물학적 순도에 대한 적절한 요건을 충족하지 못할 가능성이 있었다.
findings.text_orig: The purified water system was inadequate with the potential for water not meeting the appropriate requirements for chemical and microbial purity.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력, 경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정(calibration)·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력 및 감독이 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험에 대한 변경이 과학적으로 정당화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The changes made to the stability study of a drug were not scientifically justified.

findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)의 불만 및 의약품 품질 관련 접수 정보 처리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall) 제품의 식별 및 보관이 미흡했다. 회수 관련 절차서가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The identification and storage of recalled products was inadequate. The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조소가 교차오염 및 제품 간 혼동을 방지하기 위한 최적의 인원·자재 동선이 되도록 배치·설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed for an optimal flow of personnel and/or materials to prevent cross-contamination and/or mix-ups between products.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 격리보관 구역의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 장기보존 안정성시험에서 회사는 해당 의약품의 사용기한(retention period)을 설정하기에 충분한 빈도로 시험하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: For long-term stability studies, the company did not test the drug often enough to establish its retention period.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 진본 시험성적서(authentic certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품을 제조·포장·표시·시험하는 각 건물에 대한 상세 도면 또는 시방서의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of detailed plans or specifications was inadequate for each building where drugs are fabricated, packaged, labelled, and/or tested.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보증하는 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 효과적인 세척, 위생적 조건, 의약품 오염 방지가 가능하도록 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않은 시설에서 의약품이 제조·포장·표시·보관되었다.
findings.text_orig: The drug was fabricated, packaged, labelled, and/or stored in premises that were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to allow for effective cleaning, sanitary conditions, and/or the prevention of drug contamination.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 밸리데이션(validation) 또는 설비의 계획정비가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of equipment or the planned maintenance of equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다. 제조공정·시스템·설비·자재·공급업체의 변경이 시행 전에 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved. Changes to production processes, systems, equipment, materials, and/or suppliers were not validated before they were implemented.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 미생물 및 환경조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다. 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate. The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 습열멸균(moist heat sterilization)에 대한 회사의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 습열멸균 사이클에 대한 회사의 모니터링 및 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's validation of moist heat sterilization was inadequate. The company's monitoring and documentation of moist heat sterilization cycles was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자재가 유효기한 또는 재시험일이 경과한 후에 사용되었다.
findings.text_orig: Materials were used after their expiry date or retest date.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 식별하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 열멸균(heat sterilization) 사이클에 대한 회사의 모니터링 및 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring and documentation of heat sterilization cycles was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 효과적인 세척, 위생적 조건, 의약품 오염 방지가 가능하도록 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않은 시설에서 의약품이 제조·포장·표시·보관되었다. 원료 및 의약품이 오염 위험에 더 크게 노출되는 구역이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The drug was fabricated, packaged, labelled, and/or stored in premises that were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to allow for effective cleaning, sanitary conditions, and/or the prevention of drug contamination. The areas where raw materials and/or drugs were exposed to an increased risk of contamination were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다. 특히 무균작업 중 청정구역 내 인원의 이동이 과도했다. 무균제제 생산에 사용되는 청정구역의 상태가 미흡했다. 아이솔레이터(isolator) 내외로 자재를 이송하는 공정이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility. There was excessive movement of personnel in the clean areas especially during aseptic operations. The condition of the clean area used to produce sterile products was inadequate. The process to transfer materials in and out of the isolator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 외관검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 아이솔레이터 및 글러브·슬리브 시스템의 누출 시험이 미흡했다. 무균(aseptic) 구역의 시설과 설비에 대한 회사의 청소가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The testing of the isolator and the glove or sleeve system for leaks was inadequate. The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균시험을 위해 채취한 검체가 배치 전체를 대표하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The samples taken for sterility testing were not representative of the whole batch.

findings.text_ko: 무균(aseptic) 구역 또는 청정구역의 환경 등급 설정 절차가 미흡했다. 환경모니터링을 위해 채취한 검체 수가 부족했다. 회사는 오염 가능성이나 시스템 성능 저하를 방지하기에 충분한 빈도로 무균 충전구역을 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas. The number of samples taken for environmental monitoring was insufficient. The company did not monitor the aseptic filling area frequently enough to avoid possible contamination or system deterioration.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기류 패턴이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않음을 충분히 입증하지 못했다. 회사는 청정구역의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 시설과 설비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다. 회사는 무균제품 제조의 덜 중요한 단계에 사용되는 청정구역을 충분히 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination. The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas. The company did not adequately monitor the clean areas used for the less critical stages of manufacturing sterile products.

findings.text_ko: 제균필터의 완전성시험(integrity test)에 대한 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The documentation for the integrity testing of sterilizing filters was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 인원의 직무기술서, 인원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지할 수 있도록 보관 및/또는 운송 조건을 보증하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조 기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

documents.firm_name: Omega Laboratories Ltd. (now Juno Pharma Canada Inc.)

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험 업무의 위탁에 관한 문서화된 계약이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written agreement for outsourcing fabrication, packaging or labelling, and/or testing activities was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 외관검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용되는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 보증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

documents.firm_name: Omega Laboratories Ltd. (now Juno Pharma Canada Inc.)

findings.text_ko: 무균성 유지를 위한 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 수행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 인원에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 구매한 배지의 보관, 운송, 기록 및/또는 시험에 관하여 운영 중인 절차가 미흡했다. 조제된 배지(culture media)의 사용기한이 배지성능시험(growth-promotion testing)으로 뒷받침되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The procedures in place were inadequate for the storage, transportation, records, and/or testing of purchased media. The expiry date of the prepared culture media was not supported by the growth-promotion testing.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 판독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균시험(sterility testing)을 위해 채취한 검체가 배치 전체를 대표하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The samples taken for sterility testing were not representative of the whole batch.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 내 시설 및 설비에 대한 회사의 세척이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 청정구역(clean area)의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 시설과 설비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 또는 청정구역의 부유입자를 등급 분류하기에 휴대용 입자계수기가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The portable particle counters were inadequate to classify the airborne particulates in aseptic or clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링의 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 주요 공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용된 설비의 사용일지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 행위가 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장자재 공급업체 인증(vendor certification) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The packaging materials vendor certification program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원자재 공급업체 인증(vendor certification) 프로그램에 따른 감사보고서가 구비되어 있지 않았거나 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: An audit report was not available or was inadequate under the raw material vendor certification program.

findings.text_ko: 업체는 기류 패턴이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않음을 적절히 입증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_orig: The quality control department's documentation, labelling, and/or quarantining of raw materials, packaging materials, in-process drugs, and/or bulk drugs was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및/또는 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 배치 증명서(batch certificate)의 내용이 미흡했다. 정본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The content of the batch certificate was inadequate. The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: "Water for Injection"(주사용수)이 미생물 증식을 방지하도록 제조·보관 또는 공급되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The "Water for Injection" was not produced, stored or distributed to prevent microbial growth.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(clean area)에 대한 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written sanitation program for clean areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업자 간 문서화된 계약서의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력 및 감독 수행이 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다. 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역이 적절히 격리·구획되도록 시설이 배치·설계되지 않았다. 제품 간 교차오염과 혼동을 방지하기 위한 최적의 인원·자재 동선이 되도록 시설이 배치·설계되지 않았다. 시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 건물 내로 해충·이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated. The premises were not laid out and/or designed for an optimal flow of personnel and/or materials to prevent cross-contamination and/or mix-ups between products. The maintenance of the premises was inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 온도·습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리 요건에 대해 판정하는 책임자가 해당 직위의 책임을 수행하기에 충분한 현장 운영 지식을 갖추지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The person responsible for making decisions about quality control requirements did not have adequate knowledge of on-site operations to fulfill the responsibilities of this position.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및 문서화가 미흡했다. 다른 의약품이나 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 장비가 설치·설계·운영·보관·유지관리되지 않았다. 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행·수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및 자재의 오염 방지 조치가 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램에 직원 및 방문자의 복장 요건과 위생 절차가 명확히 규정되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate. The written hygiene program did not clearly define clothing requirements and/or hygiene procedures for personnel and/or visitors.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)를 지원하기 위해 제품 재고 및 유통 기록을 관리하는 데 사용된 전산화 시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated. The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 주요 제조 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 장비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다. 다른 의약품이나 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 장비가 설치·설계·운영·보관·유지관리되지 않았다. 측정기기의 정확성 및 정밀성을 정기적으로 점검하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. Measuring devices were not regularly checked for accuracy and precision.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및 지원 설비에 대한 적격성평가(qualification)·검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 제조기준서(master production documents)가 미흡했다. 부적합 판정된 자재 및 제품의 취급이 미흡했다. 제조공정을 관리하기 위한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)가 미흡했다. 제품 및 자재의 오염 방지 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate. The handling of rejected materials and products was inadequate. The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate. The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조에 사용되는 원료의 기준규격이 공정서(pharmacopoeia) 기준에 부합하지 않았다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다. 원료에 대한 검체 채취 계획이 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for raw materials used to produce drugs did not meet pharmacopoeial standards. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행과 실효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기준일탈(OOS), 경계값, 경향일탈(OOT)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 결과를 평가하거나 시정조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조업자(fabricator), 시험기관, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 필요한 자격 및/또는 현장 경험을 갖춘 인원 수가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The number of personnel with the necessary qualifications and/or on-site experience was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배양배지의 입고·조제·취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 보관·운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험자·포장업자·표시업자·유통업자·수입업자·도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 데 있어 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도한 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료의 검체채취 계획이 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험의 설계가 미흡했거나 문서화된 근거로 그 타당성이 입증되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design of the drug stability study was inadequate and/or not justified with a documented rationale.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적 교육이 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한 및 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조자 간 서면 계약의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 세척 절차, 세척 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및 방충·방서 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 효과적인 세척, 위생적 상태 및 의약품 오염 방지가 가능하도록 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않은 시설에서 의약품이 제조·포장·표시·보관됐다. 해당 시설은 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The drug was fabricated, packaged, labelled, and/or stored in premises that were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to allow for effective cleaning, sanitary conditions, and/or the prevention of drug contamination. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 주요 공정 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비 체계가 수립되어 있지 않았다
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. A preventative maintenance system had not been established for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 환기설비 공기질의 유지관리 및 모니터링이 미흡했다. 유틸리티 및 지원 설비에 대한 적격성평가(qualification)·검증이 미흡했다. 원료, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품, 완제품에 대한 검체의 취급 및 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance and/or monitoring of the ventilation system's air quality was inadequate. The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate. The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 재판매를 검토 중인 반품 의약품의 평가 절차에서 미흡한 사항이 확인됐다.
findings.text_orig: Deficiencies were noted with the procedure for the assessment of returned drugs being considered for resale.

findings.text_ko: 공정구역 또는 무균구역의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 내 시설 및 설비에 대한 회사의 세척이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 완제품의 무균시험에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)을 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not validate the sterility test of the finished product.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 재판매를 검토 중인 반품 의약품의 평가 절차에서 미흡한 사항이 확인됐다.
findings.text_orig: Deficiencies were noted with the procedure for the assessment of returned drugs being considered for resale.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시, 요구되는 시험, 보관 및 유통(각 조건 포함)에 관한 증빙자료의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.

findings.text_ko: 부적합 판정된 자재의 식별·격리·폐기가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The identification, quarantine, and/or disposal of rejected materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 데 있어 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품 의약품의 재판매 검토를 위한 평가·문서화·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 세척 절차, 세척 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및 방충·방서 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다. 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate. The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다. 품질경영시스템의 실효성을 실행·유지 및/또는 개선하는 데 필요한 적절한 자원을 결정 및/또는 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증거가 미흡했다. 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 대체 시험기관에 의한 확인시험(confirmatory testing)이 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Confirmatory testing was not performed by an alternate laboratory.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다. 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성, 판독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate. The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성, 판독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가, 기록, 후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조업자(fabricator), 시험기관, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증거가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 중요 제조공정에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Critical production processes were not validated.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 수행되지 않았거나 시험방법 이관(method transfer) 시험이 실시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Test methods were not validated or the method transfer studies were not conducted.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 진행 중 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 기준규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 증거가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 포장 후 및/또는 수입업자 시설에 입고된 후 의약품 각 배치의 확인(positive identification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가, 기록, 후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 위탁업체에 대한 회사의 관리감독이 미흡했다. 요구사항에 따른 전(全)항목 시험이 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company's oversight of the contracted party was inadequate. Complete testing was not performed according to the requirements.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계, 설비 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료에 대한 검체채취 계획이 미흡했다. 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업자(fabricator) 간 문서화된 계약서의 구비 및/또는 내용이 미흡했다. 각 공급업체의 원료에 대한 전(全)항목 확인시험(confirmatory testing)이 실시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate. Complete confirmatory testing was not conducted on raw materials from each vendor.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 설비에 대한 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 용수 시험에 대한 회사의 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 진행 중 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조업자(fabricator)의 원료 기준규격이 미흡했다. 의약품 제조에 사용된 원료의 기준규격이 공정서(pharmacopoeia) 기준에 부합하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The drug fabricator's specifications for raw materials were inadequate. The specifications for raw materials used to produce drugs did not meet pharmacopoeial standards.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조부서 책임자의 학력, 경력 및/또는 관리감독이 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다. 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다. 인사기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the manufacturing department was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented. The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate. The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행, 실효성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 로트 및/또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing) 및/또는 재작업(rework)을 적절히 승인·평가 및/또는 문서화하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch.
